tasks.description: Design and implement a notification system that can handle various types of events and user preferences. The system should be scalable and reliable. It should also be able to handle different notification channels such as email, in-app notifications, and SMS.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user has opted-in for notifications, when an important event occurs, then the user receives a notification within 5 minutes.

tasks.description: Identify and implement event triggers for important events such as account updates, new messages, and system alerts. These triggers should be able to notify the notification system when an event occurs.
acceptance_criteria: Given an important event has occurred, when the event trigger is activated, then the notification system is notified.

tasks.description: Design and implement notification templates for different types of events and notification channels. These templates should be customizable and able to handle different types of data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a notification template, when the template is rendered with event data, then the resulting notification is correctly formatted and contains the expected data.

tasks.description: Design and implement a system for users to manage their notification preferences. This system should allow users to opt-in or opt-out of different types of notifications and specify their preferred notification channels.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user has updated their notification preferences, when an important event occurs, then the user receives notifications according to their preferences.

tasks.description: Migrate existing notifications to the new notification system. This should include updating event triggers and notification templates to work with the new system.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing notification, when the notification is migrated to the new system, then the notification is correctly formatted and contains the expected data.

tasks.description: Write comprehensive tests for the notification system to ensure it is working correctly. These tests should cover different types of events, notification channels, and user preferences.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test case, when the test is run, then the notification system behaves as expected.

tasks.description: Implement a system to prevent notification spam and ensure that users receive notifications at a reasonable frequency. This should include implementing rate limiting and notification batching.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user has received multiple notifications in a short period, when the notification frequency is adjusted, then the user receives notifications at a reasonable frequency.
